cover.positioning: An 8 in recessed downlight for retrofit and new construction, installed from below the ceiling with its own metal-clad whip. For custom solutions please contact our sales representative.

quality_line: Wet location, IC and airtight rated, with a deep recessed light source for low glare.
description: The Universal Downlight is suitable for retrofit and new construction applications, with 120-277V input and an integrated IC-rated junction box. Wattage (12, 16 or 22W) and CCT (3000, 3500 or 4000K) are set on toggle switches on the back of the fixture. It does not need a recessed frame in new construction, and a retrofit is done from below the ceiling without removing the existing fixture, supported by the factory-installed metal-clad whip. The LC-UDL-8-GR goof ring (up to 12 in diameter) covers oversized cavities.
